bluf: Posture stays Normal: no NWS product, no credible threat naming WashU, no outage at a WashU asset, no health advisory at threshold. The decision item is the internal document exposure Student Life reported Nov 3: event security and response plans, Medical School staff schedules and cell numbers, donor and vendor records sat in OneDrive libraries open to any WashU account, some since summer; the university has changed Teams defaults and opened a review but has not said whether outside parties reached the files. The Pershing Ave shooting (child critically injured Wed 5:30 PM) has no public update and no WashU link; it is the third short-term-rental party shooting in the City in four days. NWS gives >60% odds of a light freeze Fri and Sat nights. Fri, Sat and Sun all stack, Saturday heaviest.
